THE BEST PART OF THE GAME?The people you meet.

A GUILD WITH A LITTLE SEA CHARACTER

Come for the game.
Stay for the people.

Sleep Eat AFK started with a simple idea: bring Singapore and Southeast Asian players together for WoW Forever. That idea has grown into a community looking forward to the same adventure.

We’re an Alliance PvE guild, and we’re still growing. Enjoy the game, help each other out, and make some friendships along the way.

01

02

Coming back after years?

03

Veteran or casual explorer, there’s room to come get to know us at your pace.

A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT BE WONDERING

Good to know.

Still curious? Ask us ↗
I’m completely new to WoW. Can I join?

Yes. New players, returning adventurers and long-time veterans are welcome to come meet the community. Ask questions; you don’t need to know everything before saying hello.

Do I need to know someone already?

No. There’s no need to arrive with friends or prepare an awkward introduction. Say hi, ask a question or join an existing conversation when you feel comfortable.

Do I have to rush at launch?

No. Whether you plan to chiong at launch or take your own sweet time, you’re welcome to come get to know us. Ask about individual activity expectations before signing up for an organised group.

What faction and focus is the guild?

Sleep Eat AFK is an Alliance PvE guild in World of Warcraft: Forever.

Where are most members based?

Mainly Singapore and Southeast Asia. Playing from elsewhere? Come chat and ask whether our community and usual play times suit you.

Are you recruiting my class?

Our community invitation is open. Specific class and role needs for organised groups aren’t published here; ask on Discord for the current details.

What are the raid days and times?

A confirmed raid schedule is not listed here. Check with the guild on Discord before making plans.

Can members log in and sign up for raids?

Member access and raid sign-ups are planned for a future update. The Member Login button currently takes you to the member access information below. No account or password is required yet.
